text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21 the methotrexate shortage has been on FDA's list for 43 months. Accord Healthcare Inc., Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., Hospira Inc. (a Pfizer Company), and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. all show current shortage status with various package NDCs. Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. indicates additional lots will be available in the October 2026 timeframe. Teva Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. estimates recovery in October 2026. Fresenius Kabi USA LLC advises checking wholesaler for inventory. Corvale East, General, and Lakeside hospitals hold 16-19 days of supply at current usage rates.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the methotrexate sodium injection shortage on 2023-03-13 and it remains current as of 2026-10-17.

Our position: Supply is critically low across all three hospitals. Injection presentations are most constrained. Tablet inventory provides a modest buffer but cannot replace parenteral demand. Manufacturer recovery estimates target October 2026 but are not guaranteed.

Recommended actions:
1. Place spot orders with wholesalers for any available injection lots from non-shortage manufacturers; buyer approves purchase.
2. Evaluate Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, Antares Pharma Inc., Azurity Pharmaceuticals Inc., and Eugia US LLC as alternative sources; buyer approves qualification and purchase.
3. Request allocation increases from current contracted suppliers; buyer and pharmacy director approve.
4. Report weekly days-of-supply to P&T committee until all sites exceed 30 days; pharmacy director approves reporting cadence.

Not recommended: Initiate therapeutic substitution or dose conservation protocols without P&T clinical review.
